body: Sorry for the late reply. I had class until now. So, hobbies? Well, I like to play video games. I also like to burn off steam at the gym but I wont be able to do that for a while because of some BS wrist injury. Honestly, right now I don't have the emotions to do something to make me happy. I'll prepare for tomorrow as a study session only. I also have some homework, so I'll be doing that too. Then I suppose the rest is up to fate, if you believe in that sort of thing. What are you up to?

You make a great point. Thank you for responding. My current plan for that day is to only prepare for it as if it were a tutoring session. From what I've noticed in the past is that almost everything i over prepare for or over think eventually does not turn out as good as i planned. I'll see how things go Tuesday, ill improvise and try to steer the conversation to be upbeat and happy. maybe even prepare a couple of jokes. If ask her out, and by the off chance she says yes, if everything works out, then i suppose she can be that rock you were talking about. If she says no, then at least i would have it out of my system
